chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
One cannot have sexual intercourse with the girl until she reaches nine years or ten years.

key_terms.الْجَارِيَة: The girl (specifically referring to a young female before or at the onset of maturity)
key_terms.يُدْخَلْ: To be entered into (referring to consummation of marriage/sexual intercourse)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum age for consummation of marriage in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the minimum age for consummation of marriage (bulugh) for females, citing the widely accepted view of nine or ten lunar years. In Shia jurisprudence, this age is often distinguished from the age of physical maturity (bulugh al-haydah), with scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Tusi noting that while nine is the threshold for potential fertility, full legal capacity may require additional signs of maturity. The narration reflects the early juristic consensus on the physiological readiness required for marital relations.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘One cannot copulated with the girl until there come to her nine years, or ten years’.
